mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the phase of life between childhood and adulthood, from ages 10 to 19."
Adolescence is the phase of life between childhood and adulthood, from ages 10 to 19.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key component of reproductive health; it decreases maternal and infant mortality and morbidity."
Safe motherhood is a key component of reproductive health; it decreases maternal and infant mortality and morbidity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral component of reproductive health."
Family planning is an integral component of reproductive health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for syphilis, culture and antigen testing for HSV-1 and 2 while culture for H ducreyi as well."
Serologic screening is used for syphilis, culture and antigen testing for HSV-1 and 2 while culture for H ducreyi as well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a protein produced by prostate cells and can occur in high amounts when prostate cancer is present."
Prostate-specific antigen (PSA) is a protein produced by prostate cells and can occur in high amounts when prostate cancer is present.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second most diagnosed form of cancer in men and is the sixth most frequent cause of death among all cancers."
Prostate cancer is the second most diagnosed form of cancer in men and is the sixth most frequent cause of death among all cancers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic and objective review of an ongoing or completed project to assess its effectiveness and impact."
Evaluation is the systematic and objective review of an ongoing or completed project to assess its effectiveness and impact.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a heat-sensing and processing system that uses a thermal sensitive camera to capture a digital image based on the heat radiating from the body."
CTI is a heat-sensing and processing system that uses a thermal sensitive camera to capture a digital image based on the heat radiating from the body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means professional medical and surgical care for pregnant women with a special focus on the delivery and immediate post-partum period."
Essential obstetric care means professional medical and surgical care for pregnant women with a special focus on the delivery and immediate post-partum period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential condition for ensuring that obstetric emergencies are efficiently managed."
Addressing these situations is an essential condition for ensuring that obstetric emergencies are efficiently managed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the six building blocks essential for health system strengthening."
Health Management Information Systems (HMIS) are one of the six building blocks essential for health system strengthening.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the world's largest multilateral source of funding for population and reproductive health programs."
UNFPA is the world's largest multilateral source of funding for population and reproductive health programs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means bringing together these components and establishing strong linkages with other health care and related social services."
Integration means bringing together these components and establishing strong linkages with other health care and related social services.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a data collection system specifically designed to support planning, management, and decision-making in health facilities and organisations."
HMIS is a data collection system specifically designed to support planning, management, and decision-making in health facilities and organisations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the health of women during pregnancy, childbirth, and the postnatal period."
Maternal health refers to the health of women during pregnancy, childbirth, and the postnatal period.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the care provided by skilled healthcare professionals to pregnant women and adolescent girls in order to ensure the best health conditions for both mother and baby during pregnancy."

Antenatal care (ANC) can be defined as the care provided by skilled healthcare professionals to pregnant women and adolescent girls in order to ensure the best health conditions for both mother and baby during pregnancy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a malignancy in the cervix, the narrow opening at the lower end of the female uterus, or womb that leads into the vagina."
Cervical Cancer is a malignancy in the cervix, the narrow opening at the lower end of the female uterus, or womb that leads into the vagina.
